function: Excluded, function: SAC reinforcement learning selects relay UAVs and relay power for UAV swarm anti-jamming (p. 4, p. 7), not a problem of areas 1 to 7.
notes: Exclusion code function (Step 1, check 5). The learned part is a Soft Actor-Critic (maximum entropy RL) policy whose action is the external relay UAV, the inter-swarm relay UAVs and the relay power (p. 7, Eq. 16), so the work passes no_learning and, because power is learned jointly with relay selection in aerial links, also above_phy. The paper frames its problem as anti-jamming, an excluded function: Section II.C is titled "UAV Swarm Anti-Jamming Problem Formulation" (p. 4), p. 1 states the aim "to optimize the link between UAV swarms and the ground station" under "communication and navigation jamming environments", and p. 10 speaks of "the relay UAVs' anti-jamming capability". The decision variables are relay selection and relay power in a LoS path-loss and Shannon-rate model (p. 4, Eqs. 1-4), with no satellite or NTN link, beam control, MIMO or RIS. Borderline with area 6 (power control for aerial links): if the reviewer reads the relay power allocation as area 6, the work would be included, and the marks would be q1 = 0 (custom LoS path loss, p. 4), q2 = 0 (policy tested on the training trajectory, p. 11), q3 = 1 (tabular Q-learning and Sarsa plus three fixed strategies, p. 9), q4 = 1 (O(KN_K|A|), p. 8), q5 = 0 (no code or data link).
